channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Over 800,000 student-loan borrowers will enter the new year still waiting to get their cheaper payments and debt relief approved
item.description: A recent update from the Department of Education said that just 170 student-loan borrowers received income-driven repayment discharges in November.

item.title: 8 million minimum wage workers are up for a raise in January. Some will hit a historic $15 milestone.
item.description: For the first time ever, more Americans will live in states with at least a $15 minimum wage than in those tied to the $7.25 federal rate.

item.title: I saw 34 movies in theaters this year, and I can't wait to do it again next year. Here's how the movies won Gen Z back.
item.description: I'm not the only movie theater freak out there: Gen Zers are bringing it back.

item.title: We spent a year abroad in France and enrolled our kids in a local school. Coming home was bittersweet.
item.description: Gemma Bonham-Carter says daily life in France was "blissfully different." They spent weekdays walking the kids to school, grabbing fresh bread, and working from a café.

item.title: Which states tax Social Security benefits? See the map and tax rates.
item.description: Some states tax Social Security benefits while others don't. See the map to find out if your benefits will be affected in 2026.

item.title: A 'jobless boom' is shaping up to be the story of the 2026 economy
item.description: Can't find a job, but keep hearing that the economy is strong? That might be the economic story of 2026.

item.title: How 2 men behind the Critical Role machine plan to turn the nerdworld royalty into a legacy brand
item.description: Ed Lopez and Ben Van Der Fluit were early executives on the Critical Role team. They helped the eight cofounders build a nerdworld empire in 10 years.

item.title: After high school, I chose to start a jewelry brand instead of going to college. These are 3 things I wish I knew.
item.description: Kiana Mei, 20, runs a jewelry brand and opted out of college. It's tiring, isolating work, but she says she doesn't regret it.

item.title: Mark Cuban said there's a compelling reason for new grads to join small businesses instead of big companies
item.description: The billionaire said new grads can help small and medium businesses adopt AI agents, something big companies don't need them for.

item.title: An OpenAI engineer outlines her one-week hiring sprint, from outreach on Monday to a signed offer on Friday
item.description: An OpenAI engineer breaks down OpenAI's fast, "no-nonsense" hiring process, from Monday outreach to a Friday signed offer.
